benefits.title: Why restore your headlights instead of replacing them
benefits.subtitle: Cloudy, yellow headlights cut your visibility, lower your car's value and can fail inspection. Restoration fixes all of it for a fraction of the cost of new units.

items.title: Clearly more light in the dark
items.description: Oxidised plastic scatters and dulls the beam. Once the lens is clear again, more of the lamp's light reaches the road — you see better in the dark and fog, and meet oncoming traffic more safely.

items.title: Passes inspection
items.description: Heavily yellowed or cracked lenses are a common failure. We restore the light output so your car passes the inspection.

items.title: Save thousands
items.description: New headlights often cost 5,000–20,000 SEK each fitted. Premium restoration gives you headlights like new for 899kr/pair.

items.title: Higher resale value
items.description: Clear, fresh headlights make the whole car look newer and lift its value before a sale or trade-in.

steps.title: Masking & prep
steps.description: We clean and mask the paint around the headlight so sanding never touches surrounding parts.

steps.title: Wet sanding
steps.description: Oxidised, yellow plastic is removed in stages with progressively finer paper, from coarse P400 up to P3000.

steps.title: Polymer polishing
steps.description: Fine polishing with a polymer compound restores depth, clarity and gloss to the plastic.
steps.alt: Polymer polishing a headlight to a crystal clear finish

steps.title: UV ceramic protection
steps.description: A UV ceramic coating seals the surface and shields it from the sun so the gloss lasts — with a 12-month warranty.
steps.alt: Applying UV protection to a freshly polished headlight

steps.title: Quality check
steps.description: We check the light pattern, evenness and finish in daylight and against a light source before handover.

steps.title: Ready to drive
steps.description: You get the car back with headlights that shine like new — ready for the road and inspection right away.

faq.title: Headlight restoration FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to what car owners in Stockholm ask most about headlight polishing and restoration.

items.question: How long does headlight restoration last?
items.answer: With UV ceramic protection a 12-month warranty is included. Without protection the plastic starts to yellow again within months, which is why the coating is always included.

items.question: What's the difference between headlight polishing and headlight restoration?
items.answer: In practice most people mean the same thing. Restoration describes the whole job of bringing yellowed, cloudy headlights back, while polishing is the step that removes the oxidation. We always include the full sequence — masking, wet sanding, polymer polishing and UV ceramic protection — so you get a complete restoration rather than a surface polish.

items.question: Will the car pass inspection after restoration?
items.answer: Yes. Heavily yellowed, cloudy or cracked headlights are a common inspection failure because they reduce light output. We restore the clarity so the light meets requirements — in the vast majority of cases restoration is enough to pass.

items.question: How much does it cost to restore headlights?
items.answer: Polishing both headlights is 899 SEK/pair (was 1499). PPF film is 1899 SEK/pair (was 2499). Polishing + PPF in the same visit is 2599 SEK/pair (was 3499). UV protection and a 12-month warranty are included with polishing.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A typical car takes about 45–60 minutes. You can usually wait while we work, or leave the car while you do something else.

items.question: Can all headlights be restored?
items.answer: Most modern headlights are made of polycarbonate plastic and restore beautifully. If the lens is cracked or damaged on the inside, polishing can't help — we'll tell you straight away and won't charge you needlessly.

items.question: Do I drop the car off or do you come to me?
items.answer: We come to you across Greater Stockholm — at home, at work or in the garage. Call now — we come to you.

items.question: What's the difference versus replacing the headlights?
items.answer: New headlights often cost several thousand SEK each plus fitting. Premium restoration gives you headlights like new for 899kr/pair, down from 1499kr/pair.

items.question: Can I restore headlights myself?
items.answer: DIY kits exist, but most leave out UV protection. Sanding removes the headlight's original factory coating, and without a new one the plastic yellows again within months. We sand progressively up to P3000 and seal with UV ceramic protection — which is why we can offer a 12-month warranty on a restoration.

items.question: How do I book?
items.answer: Pick a date and time in the booking calendar on this page, or call us directly. We're open Saturday and Sunday 08:00–20:00, and Monday to Friday 16:00–20:00.

items.question: Can you polish cloudy headlights?
items.answer: Yes. A cloudy surface is almost always oxidation in the polycarbonate, not dirt. We sand away the oxidised layer and polish the clarity back.

items.question: Why do headlights turn yellow?
items.answer: UV from the sun breaks down the factory coating on the plastic. After that the polycarbonate oxidises and turns yellow and dull. That's why UV ceramic protection is included in every job.

items.question: How much does it cost to replace headlights?
items.answer: New OEM headlights often cost 5,000–20,000 SEK each plus fitting. Restoring both sides is 899 SEK/pair.

items.question: Is it cheaper to restore headlights than to replace them?
items.answer: Yes, in almost every case. Restoration gives you lenses like new for 899 SEK/pair. Replacement only pays when the lens is cracked or damaged on the inside.

items.question: Can cracked headlights be restored?
items.answer: Surface scratches can be polished. A crack through the lens or moisture on the inside cannot — we'll tell you on the spot and won't charge you.
